736:t_1:326.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So, $$ノノ$$... If you're setting out into space, I'm coming too. Let's go with our heads held high.」

736:t_1:329.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Then, humble though my contribution may be, I will join you too. Even if we lose our $$トップレス$$ powers, my intellect will be of service.」

736:t_1:330.en:
$$シモン$$
「All right...! I'll take care of all of you!」

736:t_1:331.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Um... $$シモン$$... If you haven't decided where we're going yet, there's somewhere $$ノノ$$ would like to go.」

736:t_1:332.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「There's somewhere you want to go...? Is it in space...!?」

736:t_1:334.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...That $$シモン$$ is always looking forward.」

736:t_1:337.en:
$$シリウス$$
「No one will be waiting for us when the fighting ends... We are complete strangers in this world.」

736:t_1:340.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Look around. We've got so many comrades here.」

736:t_1:341.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We could work for $$ミスリル$$, go to the $$バジュラ$$ planet, or join $$大グレン団$$.」

736:t_1:345.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's go back to $$聖天使学園$$ first.」

736:t_1:346.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah. We've been training nonstop since the $$時獄戦役$$ ended, and haven't gone home.」

736:t_1:347.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I'd like to see everyone at the academy and tell them everything that's happened too.」

736:t_1:348.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Exactly! We've got to teach them how wonderful it is for men and women to unite!」

736:t_1:349.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$アンディ$$! Boys and girls dating is...」

736:t_1:351.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Besides, you're not very convincing when you say things like that, $$ＭＩＸ$$.」

736:t_1:353.en:
$$シュレード$$
「$$聖天使学園$$ will change its very purpose too.」

736:t_1:354.en:
$$クレア$$
「When the times change, people change... When people change, the times move forward... That is how it works.」

736:t_1:355.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Will $$カグラ$$ and $$ジン$$ enroll at the academy again too?」

736:t_1:356.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Before that, I'm planning to stop by $$アルテア$$.」

736:t_1:357.en:
$$ジン$$
「Come to think of it, we haven't been back since then because of $$サイデリアル$$'s invasion.」

736:t_1:358.en:
$$カグラ$$
「We'll win for that too, $$アマタ$$, $$アポロ$$!」

736:t_1:360.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We dream of a future alongside the people we love. For that too... we can't lose.」

736:t_1:362.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「Aren't you going to join everyone?」

736:t_1:364.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「Don't you have a dream, $$碇$$?」

736:t_1:365.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I want... to move into the future too. But to do that...」

736:t_1:366.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You're going to say you have to atone for the past?」

736:t_1:368.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I don't care what you do, but if you die, it's all over.」

736:t_1:371.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're going to make it back alive, idiot $$シンジ$$.」

736:t_1:376.en:
$$カヲル$$
(That's right, $$シンジ$$... A smile really does suit you, alive as you are.)

736:t_1:380.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$モーム$$. I guess I was getting a little sentimental.」

736:t_1:382.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah... Something I felt when I activated the $$時空震動弾$$... It's growing inside me again...」

736:t_1:384.en:
$$桂$$
「I always thought it was strange. A defective $$時空震動弾$$ destroying the walls of every parallel world...」

736:t_1:385.en:
$$桂$$
「But since we landed on $$エス・テラン$$, I've started to get a sense of what really happened...」

736:t_1:387.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「A $$時空震動$$ that affects every parallel world... If something like that could happen...」

736:t_1:388.en:
$$桂$$
「Surely this world... the $$カオス・コスモス$$, connected to every parallel world, had something to do with it.」

736:t_1:390.en:
$$オルソン$$
「The answer must be here on $$エス・テラン$$... The answer to true spacetime restoration, saving the universe from the great collapse...」

736:t_1:392.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Yes. That is your mission... our mission.」

736:t_1:393.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「If the universe's great collapse means spacetime collapsing in every parallel world...」

736:t_1:394.en:
$$桂$$
「Maybe we could prevent it by stabilizing the dimensional boundaries.」

736:t_1:395.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But for that, we would need to uncover how the great collapse occurs.」

736:t_1:396.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The beings that lead the universe to collapse... humanity's natural enemies... born of the force that seeks to vanish... $$バアル$$...」

736:t_1:398.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「...Are you ready, Ensign $$セツコ・オハラ$$?」

736:t_1:399.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes. As a member of $$グローリー・スター$$, I swear to act according to my duty as a soldier to the very end.」

736:t_1:400.en:
$$トビー$$
「Chief... Oaths before a final battle are out of fashion these days.」

736:t_1:401.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I think so too. That's why we'll skip leaving a last will and testament.」

736:t_1:402.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I have no intention of dying, either.」

736:t_1:403.en:
$$トビー$$
「You're shining, Chief. And not just on top of your head.」

736:t_1:404.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I'll have you know I only shave it.」

736:t_1:405.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「So that's how it is, $$セツコ$$. We'll make it back alive and share a victory beer.」
